# R packages required by the committed oracle generators.
#
# R packages are NOT per-worktree.  They install into the machine-level library
# (`/opt/homebrew/lib/R/<ver>/site-library` here), so every worktree and every
# session already shares one copy -- unlike `.venv` and `frontend/node_modules`,
# which default to one copy per checkout and therefore need
# `scripts/link-shared-deps.sh`.  Nothing here needs re-downloading per worktree.
#
# What was missing is a *declaration*.  Each generator used to name its
# dependencies only in a comment, so a fresh machine discovered them by failing
# somewhere inside an oracle run, and a package installed by hand left no record
# of why it was needed.
#
# Install everything listed here with:
#   Rscript tests/fixtures/install-r-oracle-requirements.R
#
# A missing package must make the oracle FAIL LOUDLY, never silently skip:
# a skipped oracle is indistinguishable from a passing one in the summary, and
# this release exists to remove exactly that class of invisible outcome.

# --- survey design (v1.8.7) ---
survey          # Lumley; svydesign/svyglm/svyolr/svycoxph, replicate weights, withReplicates
MASS            # polr — ordinal logit oracle
nnet            # multinom — multinomial logit oracle
quantreg        # rq — quantile regression oracle
survival        # coxph — Cox oracle

# --- DID families (pre-existing generators) ---
did             # tests/fixtures/cs_did/generate_fixtures.R
DRDID           # tests/fixtures/cs_did/generate_fixtures.R
fixest          # tests/fixtures/sa_did/generate_oracle.R
HonestDiD       # tests/fixtures/honest_did/generate_oracle.R
DIDmultiplegtDYN # tests/fixtures/dcdh/generate_oracle.R

# --- shared ---
jsonlite        # every generator writes JSON fixtures
